name: OpenEvolve
author: algorithmicsuperintelligence
one_liner: Open-source AlphaEvolve-style loop: an LLM mutates programs and your scoring function picks which survive.

loop.judged_by: a user-supplied evaluator function that scores each program
loop.steers: MAP-Elites quality-diversity archive and island populations choose which programs get mutated next

not_proved: A high evaluator score shows a program does well on that scoring function, not that nothing better exists or that the evaluator captures what you really want.
